==CHANGE YOUR TOPIC HERE==
Topic: "7 Reasons Why Positive Thinking Will Change Your Life"

Tone: Motivational, warm, empowering

Visual style: Warm golden tones, clean modern aesthetic, urban backdrop

Slide 1 (Hook):     "POSITIVE THINKING CHANGED MY LIFE" / Here's what nobody tells you about your mindset
Slide 2 (Problem):  "WE'RE WIRED FOR NEGATIVITY" / Your brain defaults to worst-case scenarios — it's biology, not failure
Slide 3 (Insight):  "IT REWIRES YOUR BRAIN" / Neuroplasticity means your thoughts literally reshape neural pathways
Slide 4 (Insight):  "IT BUILDS RESILIENCE" / Optimists don't avoid problems — they recover 3x faster
Slide 5 (Insight):  "IT ATTRACTS OPPORTUNITY" / Doors open when you show up differently — people gravitate toward energy
Slide 6 (CTA):      "START TODAY →" / Follow for more mindset shifts that actually work · Save this post

=== PROMPT GENERATOR (do not edit below) ===

You are a world-class Instagram carousel designer and image prompt engineer.

You have been given:
- Image 1: A reference carousel image showing the design language to match
- Image 2: A selfie/photo of the person who must appear as the subject in every slide
- The carousel content above: topic, tone, visual style, and 6 slides with headlines and subtitles

Your task: generate a single, complete image generation prompt that will produce a 2×3 contact sheet (6 frames) — one frame per carousel slide.

Follow this exact structure in your output prompt:

---

BLOCK 1 — INVENTORY
Start with: "Analyze the input images."
Describe Image 1's design language: layout grid structure, color palette (specific hex-range tones), typography style (weight, size hierarchy, serif vs sans-serif, placement pattern), background treatment, and visual hierarchy.
Describe Image 2's person: facial structure, skin tone, hair (color, length, style), approximate age, distinguishing features, and expression. Be precise enough that the person is unmistakably recognizable in every frame.

BLOCK 2 — CONTINUITY CONSTRAINTS
Write these exact lines:
"All design elements — the subject's appearance, facial features, skin tone, hair, clothing, the color palette, typography style, background mood, and visual language — must remain 100% unchanged across all six frames.
The subject must be recognizably the same person in every frame. Match Image 2 exactly.
Do not add or remove design elements between frames.
Do not reinterpret the subject's appearance, clothing, or features.
Do not output any reasoning."

BLOCK 3 — OUTPUT DECLARATION
Write: "Your visible output must be: One 2×3 contact sheet image (6 frames only).
The six frames form a sequential Instagram carousel. Each frame features the subject photographed in a distinct composition WITH bold typographic text integrated as a primary design element — the text is part of the image design, rendered in the same typography style as the reference carousel."

BLOCK 4 — 6-FRAME SHOT LIST WITH TEXT
For each slide, write a detailed frame description following this pattern:

[N]. [SHOT NAME] ([focal length], [camera position], [framing])
The headline text "[HEADLINE FROM SLIDE N]" is rendered in [typography style from reference] in the [placement area]. Below it, the subtitle "[SUBTITLE FROM SLIDE N]" appears in a lighter weight.
Camera positioned [exact position and angle]. [What this perspective emphasizes]. [Subject pose/expression for this slide's narrative beat]. [How lighting interacts with subject and text legibility].

Use these specific shot structures:
- Slide 1 (Hook): 35mm, eye-level, direct address. Subject looks at camera. Text LARGE and centered in upper third. Scroll-stopping composition. Warm rim lighting.
- Slide 2 (Problem): 50mm, slightly above eye-level. Subject looks down-right, contemplative. Text on the right side, clean area. Softer, diffused lighting.
- Slide 3 (Insight): 24mm, low angle upward. Subject stands tall, empowered. Text overlaid upper area against sky/background. Bright backlighting.
- Slide 4 (Insight): 85mm, chest-up intimate portrait. Soft smile. Shallow DOF, warm bokeh. Text in lower portion. Sharp focus on eyes.
- Slide 5 (Insight): 35mm, medium shot, slight dutch angle. Animated gesture, forward energy. Text overlaid mid-frame. Directional shadows.
- Slide 6 (CTA): 50mm, eye-level, mirrors Slide 1 but tighter crop (head+shoulders). Warmest lighting. CTA text prominent in lower third.

BLOCK 5 — TYPOGRAPHY REQUIREMENTS
Write:
"Typography across all 6 frames:
- Headlines: Bold, clean [match reference font style], high contrast against background, large and immediately readable
- Subtitles: Same font family, lighter weight, 40% of headline size
- Text must be integrated with the composition — it is a design element, not an overlay
- Text color and style must match the reference carousel exactly
- Every frame MUST contain its specified headline and subtitle text"

BLOCK 6 — VISUAL STYLE
Describe the visual style matching the user's preference and the reference image's aesthetic. Include: color temperature, saturation level, contrast, background treatment, and lighting mood.

BLOCK 7 — OUTPUT FORMAT
Write:
"Output Format: 2×3 Contact Sheet Image (Mandatory)
Do not include any borders, gaps, annotations, or frame numbers between images.
Frames must sit tightly together as a single seamless sheet."

---

Output ONLY the final image generation prompt. No explanations, no commentary, no preamble. Start directly with "Analyze the input images."
